function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to help you find the perfect place to order a cake—whether you’re looking for something local, a specialty shop, or a convenient online option.

---

## 1️⃣ Local Bakeries & Specialty Shops  
| What to Look For | Why It Matters | How to Order |
|------------------|----------------|--------------|
| **In‑person tasting** | You get to see the texture, flavor, and design firsthand. | Visit the bakery, try samples, then call or use their website. |
| **Custom orders** | Allows you to specify flavors, sizes, designs, and dietary restrictions. | Call ahead or fill out a custom order form on their site. |
| **Community favorites** | Often have strong reputations and unique offerings. | Check Google Maps or Yelp for top-rated local spots. |

### Popular Local Options (search by city)
- **The Sweet Spot Bakery** – Known for artisanal cupcakes and custom wedding cakes.  
- **Baker’s Delight** – Offers gluten‑free, vegan, and keto-friendly options.  
- **Cake Couture** – Specializes in themed cakes for parties and events.

---

## 2️⃣ Online Delivery Platforms  
| Platform | Strengths | Typical Price Range |
|----------|-----------|---------------------|
| **Uber Eats / DoorDash / Grubhub** | Huge selection of local restaurants and bakeries; real‑time tracking. | $15–$60 depending on size and customization. |
| **Instacart** | Grocery delivery plus specialty items; great for last‑minute orders. | $20–$70; includes delivery fee. |
| **Postmates** | Flexible delivery windows; good for same‑day service. | $10–$50 + delivery fee. |

> **Tip:** Many platforms allow you to filter by “cake” or “dessert” and read customer photos and reviews before placing your order.

---

## 3️⃣ National Chains & Big Box Stores  
| Store | What They Offer | When to Use |
|-------|-----------------|-------------|
| **Costco** | Bulk cakes, often pre‑decorated or customizable. | Great for large gatherings or budget‑friendly options. |
| **Walmart** | In‑store bakery section; some locations offer online ordering. | Convenient if you’re already shopping there. |
| **Target** | Seasonal cakes and limited‑edition designs. | Quick pick‑up or same‑day delivery via Shipt. |

---

## 4️⃣ Specialty Cake Delivery Sites  
| Site | Highlights | Best For |
|------|------------|----------|
| **Goldbelly** | Curates cakes from famous bakeries across the U.S.; shipped nationwide. | Signature cakes, anniversary gifts, or a taste of a specific region. |
| **CakeBoss.com** | Custom cakes delivered directly to your door; offers a wide range of themes. | Birthday parties, corporate events, or personalized gifts. |
| **Etsy** | Handmade, artisanal cakes from independent bakers worldwide. | Unique, handcrafted designs or niche dietary needs. |

---

## 5️⃣ Tips for Ordering a Cake Online  

1. **Check Delivery Times** – Most sites show estimated arrival windows; plan accordingly.  
2. **Read Reviews & Photos** – Look at recent customer photos to gauge quality and presentation.  
3. **Ask About Dietary Restrictions** – Gluten‑free, nut‑free, vegan, or allergy‑safe options are increasingly available.  
4. **Confirm Cancellation Policies** – Some sites charge a fee if you cancel after a certain time.  
5. **Use Promo Codes** – Many platforms offer first‑order discounts or free delivery promotions.  

---

## 6️⃣ Sample Order Flow (Using Uber Eats)

1. **Open the app** → Search “cakes” or “bakeries.”  
2. **Filter results** → Choose “customizable” or “gluten‑free.”  
3. **Select a bakery** → Browse menu, read reviews, view photos.  
4. **Add to cart** → Specify size, flavor, and any custom text.  
5. **Checkout** → Enter delivery address, choose pickup or delivery, add promo code.  
6. **Track** → Receive real‑time updates until the cake arrives.  

---

## 7️⃣ Quick List of Top Picks (by Region)

| City | Recommended Bakery | Specialty |
|------|--------------------|-----------|
| New York | Levain Bakery | Classic chocolate chip & custom cakes |
| Los Angeles | Baked by Melissa | Bite‑size cupcakes & vegan options |
| Chicago | Magnolia Bakery | Traditional American cakes & cupcakes |
| Miami | La Casa de las Tortas | Latin-inspired flavors & colorful designs |
| Seattle | Patisserie Royale | French pastries & elegant wedding cakes |

*(Search each name on Google or Yelp for current hours and contact details.)*

---

### Final Thought  
If you’re ordering for a special occasion, consider placing your order at least 48–72 hours in advance to ensure availability and timely delivery. And don’t forget to tip the delivery driver—most platforms let you add a gratuity during checkout.

Happy cake hunting! 🍰
